CREATE SCHEMA graphile_worker;

CREATE TABLE graphile_worker._private_tasks (
    id integer GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    identifier text NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE graphile_worker._private_job_queues (
    id integer GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    queue_name text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    locked_at timestamptz,
    locked_by text
);

CREATE TABLE graphile_worker._private_jobs (
    id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    job_queue_id integer REFERENCES graphile_worker._private_job_queues (id),
    task_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES graphile_worker._private_tasks (id),
    payload json NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::json,
    priority integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    run_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    max_attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 25,
    last_error text,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    key text UNIQUE,
    locked_at timestamptz,
    locked_by text
);

CREATE FUNCTION graphile_worker.add_job(
    p_identifier text,
    p_payload json,
    p_queue_name text,
    p_run_at timestamptz,
    p_max_attempts integer,
    p_job_key text,
    p_priority integer,
    p_flags text[],
    p_job_key_mode text
) RETURNS graphile_worker._private_jobs
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_task_id integer;
    v_queue_id integer;
    v_existing_id bigint;
    v_job graphile_worker._private_jobs;
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO graphile_worker._private_tasks AS tasks (identifier)
    VALUES (p_identifier)
    ON CONFLICT (identifier) DO UPDATE SET identifier = EXCLUDED.identifier
    RETURNING id INTO v_task_id;

    IF p_queue_name IS NOT NULL THEN
        INSERT INTO graphile_worker._private_job_queues AS queues (queue_name)
        VALUES (p_queue_name)
        ON CONFLICT (queue_name) DO UPDATE SET queue_name = EXCLUDED.queue_name
        RETURNING id INTO v_queue_id;
    END IF;

    IF p_job_key IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT jobs.id
          INTO v_existing_id
          FROM graphile_worker._private_jobs AS jobs
         WHERE jobs.key = p_job_key
         FOR UPDATE;

        IF v_existing_id IS NOT NULL AND p_job_key_mode = 'preserve_run_at' THEN
            UPDATE graphile_worker._private_jobs AS jobs
               SET task_id = v_task_id,
                   payload = COALESCE(p_payload, '{}'::json),
                   priority = p_priority,
                   max_attempts = p_max_attempts,
                   job_queue_id = v_queue_id,
                   updated_at = now()
             WHERE jobs.id = v_existing_id
            RETURNING * INTO v_job;
            RETURN v_job;
        ELSIF v_existing_id IS NOT NULL AND p_job_key_mode = 'unsafe_dedupe' THEN
            SELECT jobs.*
              INTO v_job
              FROM graphile_worker._private_jobs AS jobs
             WHERE jobs.id = v_existing_id;
            RETURN v_job;
        ELSIF v_existing_id IS NOT NULL THEN
            DELETE FROM graphile_worker._private_jobs AS jobs
             WHERE jobs.id = v_existing_id;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO graphile_worker._private_jobs AS jobs (
        job_queue_id, task_id, payload, priority, run_at, max_attempts, key
    ) VALUES (
        v_queue_id,
        v_task_id,
        COALESCE(p_payload, '{}'::json),
        p_priority,
        COALESCE(p_run_at, now()),
        p_max_attempts,
        p_job_key
    )
    RETURNING * INTO v_job;

    RETURN v_job;
END;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION graphile_worker.complete_jobs(job_ids bigint[])
RETURNS SETOF graphile_worker._private_jobs
LANGUAGE sql
AS $$
    DELETE FROM graphile_worker._private_jobs AS jobs
     WHERE jobs.id = ANY (job_ids)
       AND (
           jobs.locked_at IS NULL
           OR jobs.locked_at < now() - interval '4 hours'
       )
    RETURNING *;
$$;
